newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat down in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat down in heavy trade.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat prices slipped in heavy cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, traders said.

The market woke up optimistic about dryer weather helping the crop, even though there is rain forecast for the weekend. March cash wheat fell $6 to $140. Cash April maize was more sought after, boyed by export demand, and rose $1 to $98 in moderate turnover. Cash soybeans slipped in middling volume. Crop prospects look good. Cash March sunflower seed rose $2 to $214, affected by bad weather in the north which will hit yields and delay harvesting.
